topRepository.name: Sequence-to-Sequence-seq2seq-Learning-of-Hindi-Dialogues
topRepository.description: With the evolution of machine translation over the years, the research area of Natural Language Processing (NLP) has gained significant importance. The sequence-to-sequence architecture is a form of many-to-many modelling, which, in language domain belong to a particular class of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The number of researches in Hindi is low when compared to the above languages. This work involves a computational design of a language translation system which trains on English and Hindi pair of sentences through a sequence-learning approach to make predictions. Simple-RNN and Embedded-RNN based models were used for language translation modelling which showed accuracy scores of 65% and 88% respectively. For evaluation purposes, the predicted sentences were compared with the results derived from Google Translate.
